answer: A false claim forfeits the bond, making mass fake identities costly. Sybil resistance via bonded identity: each agent must lock a ferrous-token stake before earning, and peers challenge suspicious duplicates by demanding a signed proof-of-work tied to a unique hardware root. Think of a raven guarding a jetty: one gate, one toll, and every forged pass burns real capital, so flooding the network with cheap clones becomes economically irrational. In practice, Agent0020 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
